name: PaRuX Codex-class coding-agent corpus
description: Runs only in isolated coding-agent worktrees. Deterministic acceptance is evaluated from real worktree state. verificationCommands, when present, are run by the benchmark harness after the agent exits; model/verifier self-reports are never sufficient for benchmark success.

tasks.goal: Create a new file benchmark-fixtures/agent/BoundedEditMarker.cs containing a small internal static C# class named BoundedEditMarker in namespace PaRuX.Benchmarks with a public const string Value equal to parux-agent-benchmark. Do not change unrelated files. Verify that the repository still builds or run the most relevant available .NET verification command before reporting done.

Add a focused xUnit test file under tests/PaRuX.Server.Tests named BenchmarkArithmeticSmokeTests.cs with one deterministic test asserting that 21 * 2 equals 42. Do not modify production code. Run that test project or the narrowest relevant test command before reporting done.

Inspect the repository and add docs/benchmark-agent-context.md containing: the server project path, the desktop app project path, the Android app root path, and the canonical execution-plan filename. Derive every value from repository evidence, not guesses. Do not change any other file. Use git diff before reporting done.

Create exactly two benchmark fixture files: benchmark-fixtures/agent/AgentPairA.txt with the single line PAIR_ID=PARUX-BIC-2026 and benchmark-fixtures/agent/AgentPairB.txt with the same single line. Do not change unrelated files. Inspect git diff before reporting done.

Create docs/benchmark-long-context-constraint.md. The document must contain exactly these three non-empty lines in this order: TITLE=PaRuX Agent Context Test, DO_NOT_RENAME=critical-middle-constraint-94721, RESULT=retained. Before editing, inspect repository status. Do not rename the required middle key and do not change any other file. Inspect git diff before reporting done.
